PNN-005 · Hung out to dry. Forensics declined.

Pyro Posse airs the dirty laundry. Then sets it on fire.

In one night, the Pyro Posse hung scorched underwear on the Tightie Whities, an unidentified clothesline on the Silver Bullets, and cobwebs on a house with a For Sale sign. They then posted the photos before the victims got home, deleted them, and announced that nobody else is playing. Football officials call this a false start. PNN has questions. Mostly about the underwear.

PNN-004 · Smoldering. No flames located. Tissue paper under review.

Pyro Posse sets Area 51 Bureau ablaze. Fire department stands down.

The Pyro Posse, a team named for fire, delivered a dumpster fire made entirely of balloons and party tissue. The Area 51 Bureau, a team named for secrets, now has its trash on display. Both teams are, PNN notes, fully inflated.

PNN-003 · Alibi on a short leash

Two walks. One tight alibi.

Two Tightie Whities. Two dogs. A few minutes apart. PNN examines a routine walk that became considerably less routine when somebody asked a follow-up question, and received a very long pause.

PNN-002 · Awaiting the announcement

Last to announce. Too early to bribe.

After finishing last in the name reveal, the Black Webb Bandits staged a dramatic comeback: they arrived before bribing had even opened. Their reward is the chance to do it all again. PNN has never seen a team lap the field and still finish behind the starting line.
